title: Reading circuits and choosing a measurement basis
objectives: Translate circuit order into matrix order.
Implement X and Y readout using gates followed by Z measurement.
prerequisites: Chapter 3: matrix multiplication, adjoints and unitarity. Chapter 4: amplitudes, relative phase, Born probabilities and the Bloch sphere.

quizzes.question: H then S then H then T corresponds to which output?
feedback: Correct: time order and written matrix order run oppositely.
Preserve the order of every gate.

quizzes.question: Which time order implements Y readout using a final Z measurement?
options: H, then S†, then measure Z
S†, then H, then measure Z
feedback: Those gates are in the wrong order.
Correct: HS† maps plus-i and minus-i to zero and one.
A diagonal phase alone does not change Z probabilities.
